Elaborations checked and entailed: odometer "gap measured either way"; per-mile "completed contract takes precedence ... not both reductions"; return-to-brand "A pre-owned retail contract ... does not enter this credit"; on-time "months run from that charge's installment due date, not from the day it was assessed"; deferral "A pre-owned retail contract does not enter this note"; billing "Is the fee booked to principal? No".
- Cross-problem operational guidance: none (no "first call/bill ..." in any doc; each tool name appears only in its own policy's doc — scripted scan).
- Opening world state as policy fact: none; no task figure (623.20, 179.66, 205.00, 355.25, 1386.40, 41198, 41236 ...) appears in any doc or docstring (scripted scan).
- Observations (not defects): return_fee_amount closes with "Nothing in the clause depends on the mileage driven, the wear assessed or the date within the return window" — provable of the baseline clause and scoped to "the clause", so not an addition; return_fee_basis decision table uses a hypothetical lease "31 days before, disposition fee 395.00" against tier fee 450.00 — product-real figures, labelled hypothetical, not this task's 41-day row.

- Computation docs: the "every ... that applies" / "replacements first, proration second" sentences are the source's own generic assembly sentences (XF class 1/2), carried as required; no pointer, exception list or "certain customers qualify" wording beyond them. Factor docs name no computation doc and no other factor; no factor doc states which tier a customer falls on.
**PASS.**
